scope: Interim exterior, shaft/bearing interfaces, hub/pulley and separate support; unresolved internal pumping cartridge
unresolved_internal_parts: Vane count and individual vane geometry

provisional_geometry_mm.engine_engagement: 14 mm smooth shaft overlap with blind bore envelope, 2 mm bottom clearance; no helical thread or production tolerance claim

decomposition: Twenty study objects including one explicitly unresolved pumping-cartridge envelope, two unresolved bearing cartridges, three illustrative case bolts, three hub bolts and separate provisional engine support.
limits: Every numerical dimension is an assumption, not scaled from Ford artwork.
Six modeled grooves follow the common six-rib drive study, not a verified pulley catalog identity.
The internal cartridge envelope is not a single physical production part and is not counted as completed internal reconstruction.
Intake filter, hoses, bypass/diverter valves and exhaust injection connections remain unresolved.
Dry blind block bosses are explicit assumed attachment geometry, not invented wet oil/coolant passages.
No validated displacement, belt ratio, pressure/flow, motion, emissions performance or manufacturing fit.
